items.name: Little Horror: refined art direction and rank concepts

data.description: The Core tried to remember the ship's mascot and rebuilt it from the wreck's rot: a round, tar-slick thing dripping slime, crusted with clouded crystal, its grin far too wide and far too full of teeth. It has decided you are its crew.
data.artDirection: Hairless, no fur or tufts: a round-bodied, frog-like rot creature with a plump torso, a big round head and four short stubby legs with soft paw pads, and a short tapering tail. Its hide is glossy and tar-slick, streaked with thick dripping slime in the palette's accent colour. A short row of clear, faceted crystal shards juts from its back like barnacles. Round eyes with a bright pinpoint highlight. Its signature: an enormous grin that splits its face nearly ear to ear, packed with jagged white teeth. Creepy-cute, mischievous, a little unsettling.
rankConcepts: A round, tar-slick rot creature on stubby legs with a huge toothy grin, slime dripping off it, three small crystal shards on its back
A little longer in the legs and steadier on its feet; a fourth and fifth crystal shard along its back
Full adult size, still round-bodied; the grin reaches nearly ear to ear and the slime streaks run thicker
Its teeth turn jagged and crystal-tipped and its paw claws darken; the grin is now plainly a weapon
The back shards grow into one neat, even row of clear crystal, a single clean crest
Slime streaks settle into bold painted patterns across its hide in the palette's accent colour
The slime patterns glow faintly in its aura colour and the crystal crest lights from within
A collar of tarred rigging rope with a small crystal medallion, worn alongside any collar, scarf or charm it already has
Sitting up proud with one paw raised, head high, the crystal crest polished clear, grin wide
The wreck's guardian: glossy and commanding, crest of clear crystal catching the light, the same enormous grin
